sentences.text: Present:-
Mr. Gaurav Singh, Advocate for the revisionist.
Mr. Vipul Painuly, Brief Holder for the State.
Judgment
Hon'ble Ravindra Maithani, J. (Oral)

The challenge in this revision is made to an order dated 23.08.2023, passed in Special Sessions Trial No. 57 of 2023, State Vs. Yogesh Kumar, by the court of F.T.C./Additional Sessions Judge (POCSO), District Haridwar ("the case").
By it, an application under Section 311 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 ("the Code") filed by the revisionist has been rejected.

2. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
3.

The record reveals that the revisionist is facing trial in the case for the offences punishable under Sections 363, 366A, 376 (2) (n) IPC and Section 5 (l) read with 6 of the Protection of Children From Sexual Offences Act, 2012 relating to Police Station SIDCUL, District Haridwar.

entities.text: Protection of Children From Sexual Offences Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: He was provided legal aid, so that he may have his proper defence.
On 04.08.2023, PW1, the victim was examined in the case.
On that date, legal aid counsel so provided to the revisionist did not appear for the cross examination and the court closed the opportunity to cross examine PW1, the victim.
Later on, the revisionist file an application under Section 311 of the Code, seeking permission of the court to recall PW1, the victim for cross examination, but it has been rejected.
4. Learned counsel for the revisionist would submit that the revisionist is in jail.
He is not able to make his own defence on his own.
He was provided a legal aid counsel, but on 04.08.2023, when PW1, the victim was examined, the counsel did not appear to cross examine.
The opportunity was closed for no fault of the revisionist.
5. Learned State counsel would submit that the case was twice called on 04.08.2023, but none appeared for the revisionist for cross examination of PW1, the victim.

sentences.text: The revisionist was in jail.
He was provided legal aid counsel for his defence.
The legal aid counsel did not appear for the cross examination of PW1, the victim on 04.08.2023.
Now, an opportunity to cross examination has been closed.
7. Fair trial also includes within the ambit of right to defend.
In the instant case, the revisionist, who could not engage any lawyer of his own for his own defence was provided legal aid counsel, but he did not cross examine the witness.
For this reason, the revisionist may not be blamed.

Therefore,
this Court is of the view that the court below ought to have allowed the application under Section 311 of the Code filed by the revisionist.
An interference of the Court is required.
Accordingly, the impugned order deserves to be set aside and the revision allowed.
8. The revision is allowed.
The impugned order dated 23.08.2023 is set aside.
9. Application under Section 311 of the Code filed by the revisionist is allowed.
10. The Court below shall fix a date for cross examination of PW1, the victim.
On that date, she may be cross examined on behalf of the revisionist.
